headline: Crowding is both an absolute and competitive weakness.
evidence_text: Crowding draws 105 negative and 10 positive comments among 118 qualifying Amex comments; the existing peer comparison also places Amex behind sufficiently represented brands.
implication_text: Crowding is the most concentrated negative experience pattern in the measured Amex feedback.
evidence_threshold: Supported national aspect and competitive finding

headline: Food and beverage provides a credible positive foundation.
evidence_text: Positive comments outnumber negative comments 80 to 52 across 154 Amex food and beverage comments; beverage and bar is the leading detailed positive area.
implication_text: The theme provides a meaningful positive counterweight to the more negative access and capacity pattern.

headline: Space and convenience is a broad secondary pressure.
evidence_text: 77 of 139 Amex comments in this theme are negative versus 51 positive, but no single detailed area has enough evidence to explain the pattern alone.
implication_text: The weakness appears broad across the theme rather than attributable to one sufficiently supported experience driver.
evidence_threshold: Frozen theme comment population; no unsupported subtheme claim

headline: Access pressure persists across every well-supported month.
evidence_text: All seven high- or medium-sample Amex months for access and capacity lean negative, totaling 146 negative comments and 38 positive.
implication_text: The repeated negative pattern suggests access and capacity is a persistent experience issue rather than an isolated monthly spike.

headline: General feedback weakened sharply after an almost balanced June.
evidence_text: June recorded 24 positive and 23 negative Amex comments; August recorded 4 positive and 25 negative. Both months have high sample coverage.
implication_text: The shift from an almost even June mix to a strongly negative August mix is substantial although the observed data does not establish why it changed.

headline: Food and beverage remains positive in the better-supported months.
evidence_text: Across five high- or medium-sample months, Amex food and beverage feedback totals 65 positive and 37 negative comments; August turns negative but has a low sample.
implication_text: Food and beverage remains a recurring positive element; the low-volume August reversal is not enough to establish a sustained change.
evidence_threshold: High/medium trend evidence; low-sample caveat shown
